title: Momentum sync and staffing roadmap
customer_attendees: Engineers, Product, People, Ops, Sales, Research
summary: Quarterly momentum readout focused on hiring cadence, operating rhythm adjustments, and a short ops stability update. Leadership reviewed headcount burn, open roles prioritization, and a small set of process changes (monthly cadence shifts, skip-level invites). Action: People to publish updated hiring plan; Eng to freeze any non-critical hiring for two weeks pending budget remix; Ops to run a short incident tabletop and share findings. Several references to decks and the headcount tracker were made (link shared in chat).
topics: Operating rhythm changes: monthly to 6-week sprint check-ins
Short reliability readout and incident tabletop plan
Immediate next steps for managers and ICs
transcript:
Meeting header: 2026-04-28 09:30 PT | Duration: 72 minutes | Location: All-hands (virtual)
Attendees: Avery C, Maya P, Diego R, Liam O, Zara N, Sofia M, Ethan B + company-wide

[00:00] Avery: Morning, everyone. Uh, thanks for joining. I know it's early on the west coast, appreciate folks being here. Quick agenda — hiring recap, ops/infra note, then Q&A. We'll keep to 45–60 minutes for the leadership part, then open mic.

[00:24] Maya: Quick note — I put the hiring slides in the chat, headcount tracker too. Um, we've been tracking higher funnel but conversion's lagging, so Liam's team is going to tighten req prioritization.

[00:38] Liam: Yep — thanks. We looked across teams, and there are about 18 open roles we think can be deferred or pooled. We wanna avoid immediate layoffs, so the ask is pause non-critical postings for two weeks while we re-evaluate comp and role impact.

[00:55] Diego: And product will reprioritize roadmap items that require new hires. We'll surface specifically which features are delayed — not everything, just the heavy cross-team undertakings.

[01:10] Zara: From ops POV, pausing helps with distro of capacity. Also want to schedule another resilience tabletop — we had a few incidents last month that surfaced some process drift. Sofia will lead.

[01:25] Sofia: Yeah, I'll run a 90-min tabletop early next week, invite lists on the drive. Focus: cache invalidation and cross-region failover. We did find a config mismatch on the KV cache that caused token duplication on some requests — transcription may say KV cache, sometimes K-V cash — that was me earlier, heh.

[01:45] Ethan: On GTM, we'll keep outreach but tighten budgets. Sales quota unchanged, but marketing spends are being narrowed to high-conversion channels.

[02:00] Avery: Let's be concrete. Liam, publish the revised hiring plan and call out the critical roles that remain open. Maya, share a prioritized list of engineering hires tied to must-have delivery dates. Diego, publish the product impact doc. Zara and Sofia, share a TL;DR of the incident review. We'll reconvene in two weeks.

[02:18] (crosstalk)

[02:35] Audience question (Speaker 12): Are we doing any voluntary internal mobility to fill gaps before hiring externally?

[02:50] Liam: Yes, we are — internal mobility is first. We're also promoting a stretch budget for short-term contractors for high-urgency POEs.

[03:05] Audience question (Speaker 45): Can you clarify what "pause" means? Are offers being rescinded?

[03:18] Avery: No rescinds. Pause means we will not post new public reqs for two weeks and will not move forward on extended offers pending the review. No current offers that are signed will be pulled.

[03:40] Maya: Ops update — latency P95 is steady but we saw a spike in tail latency correlated with a batch processing job that coincided with backups. We're adjusting scheduling windows and improving isolation.

[04:05] Sofia: Real example — the backup window overlapped with a nightly kv-cache compaction step that caused GPU node eviction on a small set of Dedicated clusters. We're changing compaction to stagger windows and adding a preflight check.

[04:22] Diego: Practically that means a small push to the post-MVP release dates for one product line, but nothing customer-facing should see downtime if the rollout is following canary.

[04:38] (laugh)

[04:50] Avery: Okay, culture and career signal: we will run manager office hours for promotions and FY cadence, and we'll increase skip-levels with VPs doing a set of 1:1s over the next month.

[05:08] Liam: We're also updating the leveling doc — minor changes — and will put an annotated FAQ in the People site.

[05:25] Audience (Speaker 81): Will compensation changes be retroactive if someone is mid-cycle?

[05:35] Liam: We'll treat mid-cycle fairly; details in the FAQ. Also open to case-by-case.

[05:50] (brief pause)

[06:00] Avery: Quick Q&A — please use the raise-hand feature. If you have questions about the hiring pause, flag them to your manager and we'll follow up.

[06:30] Question from Eng (Speaker 97): Does this pause impact contractor approvals?

[06:44] Liam: Temporary contractor spend for critical path is allowed but requires VP approval. We'll add a fast-track signoff.

[07:05] Diego: On product prioritization, we will freeze two cross-team initiatives: user-sandbox and multi-region analytics (tentatively). We'll keep the infra pieces that prevent regressions.

[07:30] Audience murmurs, filler words.

[08:00] Zara: Ops will publish a quick ops playbook for the compaction/backup schedule and share a confluence link. Also, small change to on-call: one extra rotational day for infra till next month while we add automation.

[08:20] Avery: Leadership ask — managers, please update your team pages, and post any role transitions in the People tracker by EOD Friday.

[08:40] (soft laughter)

[09:00] Wrap: Avery: Thanks, folks. We know these are heavy asks; we'll aim for transparency. Next all-hands style readout in six weeks; I'll email the calendar.

[09:20] After meeting — open mic and some shout-outs: 
[09:30] Speaker 14: shout-out to infra for the quick rollback last week.

[09:45] Speaker 21: question about learning stipend — will it be cut?

[09:55] Liam: No change to already committed stipends. We'll review non-essential perks in the upcoming finance check.

[10:10] End of recording.

Note: transcription contains some common mis-hears (KV cache sometimes transcribed as K-V cash, names abbreviated). Deck links mentioned: (Hiring plan in drive), (Incident tabletop invite).
